title: review follow-ups of PR #37725: first-screen LCP protocol clause — non-network scripts and per-report counts
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review record 7207007610 on PR #37725, nits N5 and N6, adopted at ACCEPT)

## What happens

PR #37725 (Part of #37444) wrote the maintainer's HTTPS + HTTP/2 condition (ruling 7205984444) into checklist item `ux-conventions.first-screen-lcp` as a scored clause, "every scored run was served over HTTP/2". Its review left two items open:

- [ ] **Non-network scripts** (N5). The clause requires every `audits['network-requests']` entry with resourceType `Script` to read protocol `h2`. A `data:` or `blob:` script reads something else, which would turn every run into a control. Expected: narrow it to every network (`https:`) Script request.
- [ ] **Counts from every scored report** (N6). The clause checks every scored report, but its evidence line asks for per-protocol counts "from one report" per page. Expected: record the counts for all 15 reports, or say why one per page is enough.

Category ①: wording of a checklist clause, so that the clause and its evidence match.
Priority: p3. Today's Console loads no `data:`/`blob:` scripts on the three pages, so nothing misscores now.
Business reason: if a future build inlines one script, every first-screen reading could silently become a control, and the gate would stop scoring.
Reader: the ux lane thread that next edits `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ux-conventions.json` (the #37572 slice of #37444 is next).
Dedupe: searched open issues for `"PR #37725"`: 0 hits.
Related: #37444, PR #37725.

## Grade

area:ux · Bug · minor · reach: read · evidence: read → p3
